# Method GetDraftTableCellImage

#### GetDraftTableCellImage(ElementId, int, int, int)

Gets the image value of a cell.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 14, 300, 140)]
Bitmap GetDraftTableCellImage(ElementId inElementId, int inColumnIdx, int inRowIdx, int inSplitColumnIdx)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the entity to analyze.  |  
 
|  int |  inColumnIdx |  Index of the column.  |  
 
|  int |  inRowIdx |  Index of the row.  |  
 
|  int |  inSplitColumnIdx |  Index of the split column. 0 if default.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  Bitmap |  Image of a cell.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.14.300.140.
